profile.headline: Senior Software Developer 💻
profile.summary:
I came into engineering through a non-traditional path - creative and business roles across different industries - and that background shapes how I build. Now I work across the full stack - frontend interfaces, backend APIs, payment systems, AI tools - focused on shipping features that work well and hold up over time. I've always worked best collaboratively, partnering closely with designers, engineers, and product teams to turn ideas into reality.

You can contact me at alizenguyen@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Specialized Frontend Engineer on the time and billing team at Canopy, an accounting practice management software, with focus areas include invoicing, time tracking, reporting, and payment processing.
• Build and maintain features using React, Typescript, JavaScript, HTML/JSX, and CSS across frontend microservices.
• Updated legacy code bases to improve functionality, readability, and performance.
• Contribute to and lead infrastructure initiatives impacting both end users and internal teams.
• Led a full payment facilitator (PayFac) migration, preserving existing functionality while implementing new onboarding processes.
• Manage payment processes on the client portal and secure link, prioritizing UX and transaction security.
• Worked cross-functionally across UX design, internal/external data integration, and frontend implementation.
• Mentored and assisted with onboarding new team members.
• Contributed backend features and fixes to a Python/FastAPI invoicing microservice.
• Designed and implemented filtering and search APIs for workflows across invoices.
• Extended API response models to surface new data for frontend consumption.
• Wrote integration and unit tests against a real PostgreSQL database.
• Worked across the stack as a frontend developer to unblock feature delivery end-to-end.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · CSS · Git · Github · React testing · React · RxJS · Jira · HTML · Front-end Development · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Jest · Software Development · Anthropic Claude · Claude Skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• R&D software developer for a robotics and AI company serving NASA and other government agencies.
• Designed web application prototypes from concept using Sketch and Figma.
• Built frontend interfaces using Vue.js/Vuex and React/Redux to visualize data for the PRIDE core product.
• Wrote unit and integration tests using Mocha, Jasmine, and Chai.
• Developed Augmented Reality prototype applications on Microsoft HoloLens using Vue/Vuex, A-Frame, and Three.js, as well as locally on-device using Unity and C#.
• Collaborated with the NASA APRES team to build the UI for the Intelligent Systems Division's next-generation mission planning system for spacecraft, rovers, and landers.
• Leveraged Vue.js and OpenMCT — NASA's open source mission operations data visualization framework — for the mission planning interface.
• Contributed development support, features, and bug fixes to the NASA OpenMCT team for the framework powering the NASA VIPER lunar rover.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · CSS · Git · Jasmine · Github · Web Design · Jira · Unity · jQuery · HTML · Web Development · Vue · Mocha · Front-end Development · Jest · C#

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.description:
A small design studio crafted to create and bring the ideas of the client to life. 

I utilize Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and Procreate from conception of an idea to the creation of a polished product.

Through extensive research, strategic concept development, and an eye for detail, I create products for clients that not only fulfills their objectives but to also accurately convey their story or message.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Github · Web Design · Social Media Marketing · figma · HTML · Procreate App · Web Development · Illustrator · Photoshop

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Substitute teaching assistant for a 6-month full stack coding bootcamp based out of the University of Texas in Austin in partnership with Trilogy Education Services. 

The course focuses on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Git, Node.js. Express.js, MySQL, MongoDB, and React.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Javascript · Git · Github · Mentoring · HTML · Jest

positions.title: Project Support Consultant
positions.description: Hired as a part-time consultant providing project support as needed while concurrently completing the University of Texas Web Development Certification.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
During my stint as the Marketing Coordinator with Western Motorcoach/Greatland Tours, I directed all marketing initiatives, managed Greatland Tours social media accounts leading to over a 100% growth in followers/positive reviews/customer interaction, created digital graphics including web design layouts, and created promotions such as 55+ Thursdays and Christmas Holiday Giveaways. 

I was also an account manager for all private casino charters where I generated 500K in sales. I interacted with clients on a daily basis, managed casino bus charters from beginning to end,  communicated with all five casinos on trip details as well as any marketing strategies specifically for private charters,  and consulted and promoted casino bus packages.
positions.insights: Skills: Social Media Marketing · Marketing Strategy · Market Research

positions.title: Marketing and PR Intern
positions.description: I was brought on as a Spring Intern for a period of 3 months. My responsibilities included researching and Implementing best practices of content development and search engine optimization, designing marketing material and presentation to law firm members, and composing blog posts on a variety of marketing topics for the company's segment of "The Marketing Minute."

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
positions.description: I was brought on to the team to put together digital marketing material including social media graphics, website components, and brochures/flyers.

positions.title: Real Estate Intern
positions.description: My responsibilities as an intern was to conduct market analysis to determine tier 1/tier 2/ future trade areas nationally, create tour books and site presentations containing potential sites/demographics/maps/site overviews, produce maps containing trade area competition/roads/retail hubs, and engage in strategic meets to improve company structure and client satisfaction.

positions.title: Marketing and Business Development Intern
positions.description: As a fall intern, I designed and executed a number of marketing campaigns, organized events in accordance to a budget to target potential clients, and conduct market research of the area.

positions.title: Secretary and Client Coordinator
positions.description: My responsibilities include greeting and guiding clients at the shipping docs, generating daily earnings report, communicating with clients on fuel orders, and organizing fuel delivery.
